skill.name: project-planning
skill.description: Generates project vision, architecture decision records, technical specifications, roadmaps, and synthesis guidance from a project concept.
skill.summary: Create linked planning documents for AI-assisted software development.
skill.author: ByronWilliamsCPA

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, template placeholders, relative links, and safe local validation examples. One semantic issue remains: optional consensus review can disclose project planning content to an external MCP or model. No evidence found of prompt injection, malware intent, credential access, or malicious command construction.

remediation.issue: External consensus review can disclose private project details.
remediation.suggestion: Make the consensus step explicitly opt-in and warn users before sending documents to external models.

remediation.issue: Workflow examples include shell and git commands.
remediation.suggestion: Add a note that users should review command effects before running validation or branch commands.

content.value_statement: New projects often start with unclear scope, missing decisions, and weak plans. This skill turns a concept into linked planning documents for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Creates project vision, ADR, technical specification, and roadmap documents.
Guides document order so later plans reference earlier decisions.
Provides templates for scope, architecture, data models, APIs, risks, and phases.
Validates required sections, placeholders, document length, and local links.
Supports optional consensus review through a configured zen MCP tool.
Synthesizes completed documents into a unified project plan.
limitations: Planning quality depends on accurate project context from the user.
Consensus review requires an optional MCP server and may send content externally.
The validation script checks document structure, not implementation correctness.
Shell and git examples should be reviewed before use in a workspace.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Build
use_cases.description: Turn a product idea into scope, architecture choices, technical details, and phased delivery steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare Engineering Handoff
use_cases.description: Create concise planning documents that help developers start work with fewer missing decisions.

use_cases.title: Resume AI-Assisted Development
use_cases.description: Use planning references and prompting patterns to load only the context needed for the next task.
use_cases.target_user: Developer using Claude Code or Codex

prompt_templates.title: Create Initial Plans
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create planning documents for this project: [describe the project]. Include a project vision, one ADR, a technical specification, and a roadmap.

prompt_templates.title: Fill Placeholder Documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Existing planning files are present but empty.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find planning files with Awaiting Generation status. Replace them with project-specific content for this project: [describe the project].

prompt_templates.title: Review Planning Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my project vision, ADRs, technical specification, and roadmap for conflicting assumptions. List actionable fixes before writing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Delivery Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff after all planning documents are complete.
prompt_templates.prompt: Confirm all planning documents are complete, then synthesize them into PROJECT-PLAN.md. Include phase branches, risks, dependencies, and next steps.

output_examples.input: A founder describes a finance CLI and asks for a development plan.
output: A project vision with target users, scope boundaries, and success metrics.
An ADR that records the storage decision and trade-offs.
A technical specification and roadmap aligned with the selected stack.

output_examples.input: An engineering lead has separate planning documents and wants one execution plan.
output_examples.output: A synthesized project plan with phases, branch naming, dependencies, risks, and next actions.

output_examples.input: A developer wants to continue work without loading every planning file.
output_examples.output: A focused context plan that names the relevant sections, decisions, and next implementation task.

best_practices: Provide concrete constraints, target users, and success metrics before generation.
Review each generated document before using it to guide implementation.
Remove confidential details before sending documents to external review tools.
anti_patterns: Do not generate plans from a vague idea without clarifying assumptions.
Do not treat roadmap estimates as commitments without team review.
Do not run shell or git examples without checking their workspace impact.

faq.question: Does this skill write application code?
faq.answer: No. It creates planning documents that guide later coding work.

faq.question: Which documents does it create?
faq.answer: It creates a project vision, ADRs, a technical specification, and a development roadmap.

faq.question: Does it require the zen MCP server?
faq.answer: No. Consensus review is optional, and manual review can replace it.

faq.question: Can it validate generated documents?
faq.answer: Yes. The included script checks required files, sections, placeholders, length, and local links.

faq.question: Can I use it for sensitive projects?
faq.answer: Yes, but remove confidential details before using external consensus review.

faq.question: Can it work with existing planning files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update placeholder planning files and align existing documents.
